title: ALMA Investigation of Vibrationally Excited HCN/HCO<SUP>+</SUP>/HNC Emission Lines in the AGN-Hosting Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxy IRAS 20551-4250
question: Do HCN, HCO+ and HNC show vibrationally excited (v2=1f) J=3-2 emission in the AGN-hosting ULIRG IRAS 20551-4250, and does infrared radiative pumping and abundance explain the enhanced HCN-to-HCO+ ratio?

what.value: HCN/HCO+/HNC J=4-3 fluxes from ALMA Cycle 0

evidence.quote: HCN J=4–3 fluxes at v$_{2}$=1f and v=0 are from (cite: ima13b).
Values in Cols. (3) and (4) are from the Cologne Database of Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS) (cite: mul05) via Splatalogue

what.value: Vibrational A coefficients A(v2=1-0): HCN 1.7, HCO+ 3.0, HNC 5.2 s^-1

evidence.quote: $\sim$1.7 s$^{-1}$ (HCN) (cite: deg86; aal07a), $\sim$3.0 s$^{-1}$ (HCO$^{+}$) (cite: mau95), and $\sim$5.2 s$^{-1}$ (HNC) (cite: aal07a)

recipe.method: CASA clean after continuum subtraction; moment 0/1/2 maps; imfit for sizes
Gaussian fits to spectra at continuum peak; upper limit from moment 0 for HCO+ v2=1f

recipe.goal: Predict infrared pumping and derive abundance ratios
recipe.method: Compare observed v2=1f J=3 column density ratios with predicted pumping using B coefficients, Spitzer IR continuum at 12/14/21.5 micron
assumptions: Same emitting region and optically thin v2=1f; foreground screen dust; AGN-dominated mid-IR continuum

recipe.goal: Estimate line opacity and excitation temperatures
recipe.method: HCN/H13CN ratio with 12C/13C 50–100; clumpy flux attenuation tau/(1-exp(-tau)); T_ex from v2=1f/v=0; pumping condition test

answer_key.quantity: HCO+ v2=1f J=3-2 flux upper limit

evidence.quote: we adopt the flux attenuation of HCN J=3–2 emission to be 6
are 1.6$\pm$0.2 for HCN, 1.7$\pm$0.2 for HCO$^{+}$, and 1.8$\pm$0.2 for HNC

not_stated_but_needed: clean weighting/robust, deconvolver, threshold and masks
specific line-free channels and continuum fit order
Spitzer IRS spectrum data reduction and power-law fit wavelength ranges
missing_for_reproduction: Spitzer spectrum processing and power-law fit ranges
score_reason: Data identified and results numeric, but imaging parameters and IR continuum fitting are sparsely specified.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data; line fluxes in tables are checkable via simple imaging and Gaussian fits.
